director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: At cycle 38077778225 all six scientific lanes hold an active PREFREEZE experiment under an explicit mandate and no lane is idle; nothing is frozen-and-pending, so every decision here is about pre-freeze direction. The central shape of the program is unchanged from the cumulative global audit: SPIDER has bounded, audited evidence for a procedural/parameterized inheritance thesis (a live distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute path, a bounded intervention-valid substrate, a replicated freshness extraction defect, a canonical negative on value persistence in public HTTP) but has NOT demonstrated the decisive claim - a real external LLM agent paying materially less fully loaded cost per successful partially novel Web task against cold/instructions/retrieval with the same model, tools and budget. The binding near-term critical path is B1 (shipped parameterized carrier plus a known-negative refusal certificate, Product), B2 (certified non-degenerate task bank with genuine comparator headroom, Runtime) and B3 (a capable same-model driver or an explicit close/re-scope, Intel). Per the readiness rule, no expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution is authorized this cycle, and no lane is assigned the four-arm benchmark. I therefore CONTINUE Product, Runtime and Intel on exactly those three gates; CONTINUE Graph on its terminal, fail-loudly C-FRESHNESS D1V constructibility test because the promoted carrier must carry a freshness/applicability guard and this test decides whether a >=2-anchor clustered false-accept bound is even constructible (the historical pre-2.0 volatility-freshness program already closed PAUSE_CLOSE_NEGATIVE for lack of longitudinal data, so a calibrated TTL policy must not be assumed); CONTINUE Physics only because its access-barrier-stationarity mandate carries a pre-freeze attainability certificate that makes it cheap and product-relevant (denylist validity horizon / re-probe interval) and must fail loudly to a park if the frame is unattainable; and PIVOT Frontier off the repeatedly-unattainable site-native-discovery frame (BLOCKED, empty sampling frame, same_failure_count=8) onto a provenance-separated C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE test, a neglected core capability whose exact next gate is defined and whose design is certifiable without real sites or a non-degenerate benchmark. Portfolio friction (58.8% REVISE+MEASUREMENT_INVALID, 26.0% MEASUREMENT_INVALID) continues to read as an upstream prerequisite-repair problem; the certificate-bounded mandates below are the one-time repairs rather than further exploratory re-parameterizations.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout was not degraded (model_scout status=success). Its brief materially shaped but did not dictate this allocation. I accepted its central reading, which my own reading of codex/claim_state.json and the global audit confirms: B1/B2/B3 dominate the critical path, the freshness/physics/frontier bounded threads are low marginal value, and the last Frontier packet was BLOCKED with an empty sampling frame. I challenged and moderated three of its suggestions: (1) rather than PARK Physics outright, I continued its access-barrier mandate because that specific design already carries a pre-freeze attainability certificate with a fail-loudly park, giving a cheap decisive outcome with product decision value (denylist/re-probe policy); (2) rather than re-attempt the Frontier site-native-discovery frame with a certificate (which the Scout itself flagged as risking a second unsatisfiable design after 8 failures), I re-scoped the lane to C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE; (3) I did not adopt its orthogonal 'incremental-computation / cache-invalidation' candidate for Frontier because the historical archive shows that is exactly the pre-2.0 frontier web-physics-volatility-freshness program, which closed PAUSE_CLOSE_NEGATIVE and explicitly requires longitudinal collection - resuming it would risk replaying a closed negative. I independently surfaced that historical closure from codex/legacy_artifact_index.json and the frozen source, which strengthened the Graph and Frontier decisions. The Scout's external competitor items (AWM, QCR, ActionEngine, WebChoreArena) are recorded as external prior art to be verified by Intel later, not as SPIDER evidence.
